section_summary.extract_value: This section details the procedure for a psychological study conducted among university students in Tehran, Iran, between December 2014 and June 2015. It describes the translation and back-translation process for the BAS-2 into Persian and mentions that data was collected using a paper-and-pencil survey method in classroom settings.
